title: Outside Lands 2026 Livestream: How to Watch Charli xcx, The Strokes & Rüfüs Du Sol Online for Free
summary: Get livestream feeds of must-see festival performances starting Friday (Aug. 7).
contentText:

Outside Lands 2026 launches its online broadcast event this weekend, while this year’s music festival takes place at Golden Gate Park in San Francisco.

On Friday (Aug. 7), until Sunday (Aug. 9), Amazon Music livestreams Outside Lands to give fans access to the festival, even if they’re not in the Golden State. For 2026, the headliners during the main festival days are Charli xcx, The Strokes and Rüfüs Du Sol, while other must-see acts on the roster include Turnstile, Glorilla, Geese, Wet Leg, Dijon, PinkPantheress, Audrey Hobert, Baby Keem, Death Cab for Cutie, and others.

watch on Prime Video

How to Watch Outside Lands 2026 Online for Free

To livestream Outside Lands, you’ll need a subscription to Amazon Music or Prime Video .

Outside Lands 2026

Livestream performances by Charli xcx, The Strokes, Rüfüs Du Sol and others starting on Friday, Aug. 7.

Outside Lands 2026 Festival Lineup

Outside Lands, Day 1

Livestream performances by Charli xcx, Turnstile, Labrinth and others.

For Friday (Aug. 7), the music festival livestream includes performances from Glorilla, Geese, Clipse, Wet Leg and Modest Mouse.

Outside Lands, Day 2

Livestream performances by The Strokes, The xx, Djo and others.

The livestream on Saturday, Aug. 8, features Dijon, PinkPantheress, Ethel Cain, Lucy Dacus, Malcolm Todd, Audrey Hobert, Snow Strippers, DJ Trixie Mattel and Yard Act.

Outside Lands, Day 3

Livestream performances by Rüfüs Du Sol, Baby Keem, Empire of the Sun and others.

And to close out the festival, on Sunday (Aug. 9), you can livestream performances from Death Cab for Cutie, Disco Lines, Mariah the Scientist, Not for Radio, Jade and Miss Monique. Check out the complete lineup here .

Livestream Outside Lands 2026 on Prime Video starting Friday (Aug. 7), with a start time of 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT.
